sections.heading: What Makes a Great Packshot
sections.body:
A packshot is a clean product photograph optimized for commercial use. The best packshots share these qualities:

  • Clarity: Every detail visible and sharp
  • Consistency: Uniform style across product lines
  • Clean background: Pure white or seamless gradient
  • Accurate colors: True-to-life product representation
  • Professional lighting: Even illumination with subtle shadows for depth

AI packshots can match studio quality when configured correctly.

sections.heading: Background Selection
sections.body:
Choose the right background for your use case:

Pure White (#FFFFFF): Amazon main images, Google Shopping, clean marketplace listings. Requires no shadow for true white background compliance.

Light Gray (#F5F5F5): Adds subtle dimension while maintaining clean aesthetic. Great for Shopify and direct-to-consumer sites.

Gradient: Smooth transition from light to slightly darker. Creates depth without distraction.

Colored: Brand-specific backgrounds for marketing materials. Match to brand guidelines.

sections.heading: Lighting Techniques
sections.body:
Packshot lighting eliminates harsh shadows while creating dimension:

Three-Point Lighting: Key light (main), fill light (shadows), back light (separation). Classic studio setup.

Soft Box Diffusion: Large, diffused light sources create even illumination.

Reflection Control: For glossy products, control reflections with positioning and matte surfaces.

Shadow Intensity: Subtle shadows ground the product. Avoid floating product syndrome.

sections.heading: Angle and Composition
sections.body:
Standard packshot angles for comprehensive product coverage:

Front-Facing: Primary angle showing brand and product name. Label fully visible.

Three-Quarter: Shows front and side for dimensional understanding.

Profile: Side view for packaging depth and unique features.

Top-Down: Cap, lid, or opening details. Secondary angle.

Generate all standard angles to build complete product assets.

sections.heading: Product Preparation Tips
sections.body:
Before generating AI packshots, ensure your product reference is clean:

  • Clear reference image: Remove previous backgrounds or clutter
  • Multiple angles: Provide various views for AI reference
  • Color accuracy: Use calibrated photos or adjust in post
  • Detail visibility: Ensure labels and text are legible

Better input = better AI output. Quality reference images are essential.

sections.heading: Batch Processing Workflow
sections.body:
Efficient packshot production follows a systematic approach:

  1. Organize products: Group by category, size, or style
  2. Create templates: Define background, lighting, and angle presets
  3. Batch generate: Process similar products together
  4. Quality review: Check consistency and color accuracy
  5. Export and name: Use consistent naming conventions
  6. Organize assets: Folder structure by product/angle/version

This workflow scales from 10 to 10,000 SKUs efficiently.
